description: This file contains SQL schema definitions for a Learning Management System backend, including table creation for profiles, lessons, quizzes, assignments, and quiz submissions, as well as related indexes and extensions.
calls: create table if not exists public.profiles
create table if not exists public.lessons
create table if not exists public.quizzes
create table if not exists public.assignments
create table if not exists public.quiz_submissions
create index if not exists idx_assignments_assignee_user
create index if not exists idx_assignments_lesson_id
create index if not exists idx_assignments_quiz_id
create index if not exists idx_quiz_submissions_user_id
create index if not exists idx_quiz_submissions_quiz_id
create index if not exists idx_lessons_owner
